title: More daily health on Progress
highlights: Progress now charts resting heart rate, blood oxygen (SpO₂), sleep, and VO₂ max from Health Connect—alongside steps, active calories, and average heart rate.
Today's stat cards rotate through the new vitals and sleep when your watch or phone reports them.
Settings → Cardio & sensors shows whether background Health Connect updates are allowed so daily totals can refresh when you return to the app.

title: Health Connect routes on import
highlights: Importing a cardio session from Health Connect can now pull the watch or phone route—Health Connect may ask you to allow route access for that session.
Imported routes show the same map polyline as app GPS tracking on the cardio row and in workout history.
Re-import a recent session (within 48 hours) if you imported before routes were available—uncheck the done checkbox on the row to show Import again.

title: Suggest rep increases
highlights: Settings → Device & timers → Progression: turn on Suggest rep increases to get optional Library default bumps after strong sessions.
When you're ready, a Ready to level up? card appears on Today after you finish a workout—tap to review exercises and accept +2 reps or seconds.
Snooze for 14 days or ignore per exercise; ignored exercises can be re-enabled in Settings or Library.
